query: Does this repository provide complete Claude support for 2026 AAA custom game-engine development alongside its existing game-development workflows?
mode: bounded capability audit and primary-source research
provider: built-in web search and open; local read-only repository inspection
scope: Agent responsibilities, rules, routing, workflows and evidence standards; not implementation of a game engine
assumptions: AAA describes production requirements rather than a standardized set of job titles.
Existing roles may own multiple capabilities when boundaries and evidence are explicit.
Specialized simulation and inference capabilities are selected per project, not compulsory features.
Current retrieval does not make older engineering practices new in 2026.
constraints: Repository-only artifacts; no home-directory writes or GUI output.
Report length bounded by the task to 2000-3500 words instead of the generic skill's long-report target.
No commercial engine was compiled, no console SDK was inspected, and no Claude behavioral execution is claimed.
